hook_line: AIR INDIA FORMS COST-CUTTING TEAM AFTER RECORD LOSS

hook_stat.sub: Air India's loss for the fiscal year ended March — its largest yet

news_summary: Air India has set up a cross-functional cost-cutting team and tightened spending approvals after posting a record $2.3 billion loss for the fiscal year ended March.
payoff: Equity terms with Tata Sons and Singapore Airlines, and maintenance and delivery talks, will determine the pace of the turnaround.
